settings.heading: The Importance of Rug Padding: Why You Need It for Comfort and Longevity

settings.text: There's nothing better than investing in an exquisite rug-beautifully handwoven Persian, a work of art that takes you centuries away from a new trendy design-and not lose it as you wish the beautiful pieces were there forever and look perfect even after all these years. Little do we know, the simplest way of extending its lifetime and improving its comfort is actually by rug padding. In this post, we’ll explore why rug padding is so important and how it can benefit both your rug and your home.

Probably one of the most obvious advantages of a rug pad under your rug is its comfort level. A rug pad adds a softness and padding which makes walking, standing, or sitting on the rug feel softer and more comfortable. This is highly beneficial for the living room, kitchen, or hallway, as these areas are mostly visited when you are standing or walking on your feet with your guests.
Furthermore, rug padding reduces noise in the room. The soft layer underneath the rug acts to dampen the sounds, making echoes less prominent and the place more quiet and serene.

Rug pads help the rugs prevent as much wear and tear from everyday usage. A direct rub against a floor without a rug pad leads to friction, so the fibers eventually break down that much faster; a quality rug pad cushions everything, reducing friction by allowing a distance between the carpet and the underlying floor.
Furthermore, the rug can also prevent movement of the rug to bunch or bunch up due to time factors. This applies in areas that receive much traffic because rugs always shift and bunch in such regions. By fastening the rug into place, padding reduces stress placed on fibers so that the shape is maintained as well as its shape not to become damaged.

settings.text:
Safety is the other major issue about rugs at your home. At times, carpets, especially where there is more movement, might have slipped out of place, leading to falling down. It becomes a serious issue, especially in households where there are little children, aged relatives, or pets.
The rug pad anchors the rug to the floor, which would otherwise slide or bunch up. This additional stability can drastically decrease the number of accidents and thus make your home safer for all of its members.

While the obvious reason for getting a rug is its aesthetic contribution to your interior space, the real function of rugs lies in floor protection. Your hardwood, tile, or carpeted floors all can be exposed to scratches and stains, as well as other forms of general wear and tear. And then there's the time and damage inflicted upon the floor because the rug would rub against it.
One particular reason for applying a rug pad is to eliminate moisture build up in hardwood floors especially, which will damage the floors or cause molding. A rug pad can help absorb dirt or debris that won't get pressed between the floor and the rug.

The right rug pad is good for enhancing the look of your rug. A good-quality pad will make sure that your rug remains flat and smooth, it does not wrinkle or curl at the edges. It further adds a well-shaved appearance to the rug, making it look even more attractive in your space.

settings.text:
The type of rug and floor, therefore, comes first when picking a rug pad. Felt, rubber, memory foam, among others, can be used. Depending on the type, each has specific benefits:

  • Felt rugs are ideal for delicate floors, such as hardwood; they are meant to provide cushioned support that does not harm the floor.
  • Rubber pads have good grip to rugs, thereby giving them the required non-slip nature, so perfect for highly trafficked rooms or houses with kids or pets.
  • Memory foam pads give an additional layer of softness and comfort and are used with large area rugs in a living or dining area.

Use a pad slightly smaller than the size of the rug to avoid peeping out at the edges.

Rug padding is usually one of the most overlooked yet very important components of rug ownership. Beyond comfort and protection, it keeps your rugs from damaging the beauty of your floors and makes your home safer at the same time. Perhaps you want to add years onto the life of your rug, make it more comfortable, or ensure that it stays in place; the best choice for a homeowner would be to invest in a good rug pad.

So the next time you are buying that perfect rug don't forget adding a rug pad to your basket. Your rug-and your house-will love you for that!
